In the DISPLAY group, I need to exclude cassette rows. So, I want to change "...displayRows(cfg)" to "...displayRows(cfg) where not cassette?" That way, if the configuration is CassetteScreenConfig, it’ll return empty.

Instead of making it complicated, I think a more straightforward method would be to wrap it in an if statement: if (cfg is! CassetteScreenConfig)...displayRows(cfg), else...[]. This prevents duplicates and aligns with the requirement to move the full cassette list, without showing the group header.
